description: Na₂U₂Si(O₄F)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/amd space group. Na is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent UO₆F pentagonal bipyramids and faces with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.58 Å. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.33 Å. U is bonded to six O and one F atom to form distorted UO₆F pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with six equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent UO₆F pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.49 Å. The U-F bond length is 2.21 Å. Si is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent UO₆F pentagonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent UO₆F pentagonal bipyramids. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent U and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one U atom. F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one U atom.
